exercises.why: **Подойди** — подойти́ (perfective): to approach, to come to, to walk to, to draw near; to fit, to suit, to match, to be right. Wiktionary: подо- + -йти.
exercises.context: Which prefix? The English says which word it is.

to confirm, to corroborate, to bear out, to endorse, to ratify, to verify
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: подожда́ть — to wait; подхвати́ть — to catch (up), to pick up, to grasp, to snatch; подборо́док — (anatomy) chin; подтверди́ть — to confirm, to corroborate, to bear out, to endorse, to ratify, to verify.
**подходят** — подходи́ть (imperfective): to fit (of an object, to match another object); to come up (to), to approach, to go up (to); to approach; to do (for); to suit. Wiktionary: под- + ходи́ть.
